_notes: Shared rack layout, identical for both arms. Lengths in mm, angles in deg.
World frame [U, V, W] = arm base frame: origin on the base axis at plate level, W up.
Tag frame: x along detected corner 0 -> corner 1, y 90 deg counterclockwise from x seen from above.
yaw_deg = direction of the tag's x axis in the world frame, measured from +U toward +V.
offsetTag_mm = [x, y] from the tag centre to the point of interest, in the tag frame.
null = not measured yet. Required values that are null stop the program with a message.
